result.topic_en: The page combines a list of page references to journal volumes (B. 91-93) on topics such as elastic and magnetic induction, double refraction, metallic reflection, Fresnel's reflection formulas and aberration with scattered calculations: piecewise-linear solutions in x and t, partial derivatives of logarithmic and exponential expressions, and a transformation of a second-order PDE to coordinates $\sigma, t$.
